settings.time_unit: mean host time of a pass with every chunk queued, from the chunk time run

definitions.stale_after_newer_ms_per_stop: for a stopped pass, the time from the newer request's arrival to the end of the pass, mean over stopped passes
definitions.stopped_pass_ms: whole length of a stopped pass, mean over stopped passes
definitions.stale_gpu_time_share: length of every pass whose result is not adopted over all pass length
definitions.synchronizes_per_pass: event waits plus the closing synchronize, mean over passes
definitions.mean_adopted_age_ms: from a request's arrival to the end of its adopted pass
definitions.low_and_high: smallest and largest of the single replays, one for each seed and draw

note: Predictions from a model, made before any depth run. Nothing here is a measurement or a latency bound. The assumptions are listed in tools/gpu_depth_predictions.py.
